description: This file defines structures and logic for locating and verifying the runtime environment for OpenClaw, specifically focused on the Node runtime. It includes version parsing, comparison, and error handling, as well as functions to find executables and read their version info.

classes.name: RuntimeVersion
classes.description: Represents the version of the runtime with major, minor, and patch components, supports comparison and initialization from a string.

classes.name: RuntimeResolution
classes.description: Contains details about the located runtime, including its kind, path, and version.

methods.name: from(string:)
methods.description: Parse a version string into a RuntimeVersion object, supporting optional leading 'v' and ignoring trailing metadata.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Main function in RuntimeLocator to find the runtime executable, verify its version, and return resolution info or errors.

methods.name: describeFailure
methods.description: Provides a human-readable explanation for runtime resolution errors.

methods.name: findExecutable
methods.description: Searches given paths for an executable with a specific name.

methods.name: readVersion
methods.description: Runs the binary with '--version' to obtain version string, also logs execution time.
